entities.name: Adeimantus of Collytus

entities.summary: Adeimantus of Collytus, son of Ariston of Athens, was an ancient Athenian Greek best known as Plato's brother. He plays an important part in Plato's Republic and is mentioned in the Apology and Parmenides dialogues.
